# Comfy Recraft 4.1 flash- Text to Image

Generate images from text prompts using Recraft V4.1 Flash, a fast, low-cost model that produces one image output with no file inputs required. Ideal for high-volume generation, rapid iteration, photography and portraits, atmospheric scenes, and quick logo concept exploration. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_recraft_v4_1_flash_t2i.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Extreme low-angle shot of a female athlete stretching under an overpass, emphasizing a prominent light-colored running shoe with orange accents in the foreground. She wears a dark jacket, cap, sunglasses, and light blue socks. Dramatic mixed lighting contrasts dark bridge shadows with bright background daylight. Captured with a wide-angle lens for dynamic forced perspective. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.
